reply.text:
Lazy days happen, and they don't mean anything is wrong with you. Showing up counts for more than showing up at full tilt.

Here's a deal: start the warm-up and give it 10 minutes. If it still feels flat after that, we cut the session short and call it done. Most days the work gets going once you're moving, and on the days it doesn't, a short session still counts.

If you'd rather go lighter from the start, tell me and I'll set up something easy for today. What sounds better?
